hero.title: Master of Business Studies (MBS) in Finland
hero.subtitle: A Master of Business Studies (MBS) in Finland is a useful search term for students looking to pursue advanced education in business management, finance, marketing, entrepreneurship and international business. However, Finnish universities generally award qualifications under official titles such as Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration or Master of Business Administration (MBA) rather than a degree specifically titled MBS.
